breakdown.description: The pipe is simultaneously described as horizontal/same elevation and having a 15 m elevation difference (contradictory geometry).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the contradiction. It repeated the user's flawed premise verbatim: "A horizontal pipe connects two points at the same elevation; the outlet is 15 m higher than the inlet." The ground truth correctly removes the "horizontal/same elevation" part to make the prompt physically possible.
